title: JOB VACANCY CALL FOR STOCK OPERATOR
html:
JOB VACANCY CALL FOR STOCK OPERATOR
  • Solicitation Number: G3Biz/HR/001/10/2026
  • Issuance Date: 09/10/2026
  • Closing Date/Time: 23/10/2026
  • Point of Contact: 671612797 / 653552562
  • Position Title/Number Needed: Stock Operator (01)
  • Duty Station: Limbe, South West Region, Cameroon
  • Job Type: Full Time
  • Reporting Line: Stock Management Supervisor

Global Strategic Business Limited (G3-Biz Ltd) is a dynamic beverage distribution company committed to disciplined market expansion, responsible commercial execution, and ethical business practices.

We are seeking a disciplined, reliable, and honest Stock Operator to support stock handling, storage, loading, and offloading while maintaining accuracy, warehouse cleanliness, safety, and teamwork.

Key Responsibilities
  • Receive, move, stack, and arrange products in designated locations, following approved stock rotation procedures.
  • Load and offload products carefully, verifying quantities against approved documentation.
  • Support stock checks, audits, and investigations, and promptly report discrepancies, damage, or losses.
  • Maintain cleanliness and safe stacking in the warehouse and loading areas.
  • Protect stock from theft, misuse, contamination, and damage. Move or release stock only with proper authorization.
  • Work cooperatively with the Storekeeper, Drivers, Sales Teams, and fellow Stock Operators.
  • Follow company procedures, safety rules, and lawful instructions; maintain punctuality and use equipment responsibly.
Qualifications and Competencies
  • Minimum qualification: First School Leaving Certificate.
  • Experience: Warehouse experience preferred.
  • Technical skills: Stock handling, loading and offloading, and warehouse housekeeping.
  • Personal qualities: Honesty, discipline, accountability, and teamwork.
How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit their CV and application letter at the G3-Biz Ltd office, Mile 2, Limbe, by 23rd October 2026 on or before 05:00 pm.

Due to the urgency of the position, G3-Biz has the right to recruit a candidate who matches the required profile before the above deadline.

Closing date: 23 October 2026, 5:00 pm
